name: Apple iPhone 15 Pro Max
description: Experience the ultimate iPhone with a strong and light titanium design, a powerful new camera system, and the A17 Pro chip for next-level mobile gaming.

name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
description: Unlock new ways to create, play, and connect with Galaxy AI. Features a durable titanium frame, a high-resolution 200MP camera, and a bright, flat screen.

name: Nokia 3310 Retro Classic
description: A classic reborn. The legendary Nokia 3310 returns with its famous silhouette, long-lasting battery life, classic Snake game, and modern colorful variants.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones
description: Industry-leading noise-canceling headphones with dual processors, eight microphones, Auto NC Optimizer, and exceptional call quality with modern sleek design.

name: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Generation)
description: Feature active noise cancellation, adaptive transparency, personalized spatial audio, and an enhanced MagSafe charging case with precision finding.

name: Logitech G915 TKL Mechanical Keyboard
description: Low-profile mechanical gaming keyboard with high-performance LIGHTSPEED wireless, advanced LIGHTSYNC RGB, and aircraft-grade aluminum alloy top plate.

name: Sony SRS-XB100 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: Super-compact portable speaker delivering powerful, clear sound with up to 16 hours of battery life, waterproof and dustproof exterior, and handy strap.

name: Dell UltraSharp 27 4K Hub Monitor
description: Maximize productivity with a 27-inch 4K USB-C hub monitor featuring wide color coverage, ComfortView Plus, and extensive connectivity options.

name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 Gaming Laptop
description: High-performance gaming laptop powered by AMD Ryzen 9 processor and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070, featuring an 120Hz OLED Nebula Display in a compact form factor.

name: Dell XPS 13 Aluminum Ultrabook
description: The world's smallest 13-inch laptop with a stunning InfinityEdge display, crafted from machined aluminum and woven carbon fiber for lightweight durability.

name: Apple Watch Series 9 GPS
description: The ultimate device for a healthy life is now even more powerful. S9 chip enables a super-bright display and a magical new double tap gesture.

name: Casio G-Shock Classic Analog Watch
description: Shock resistant, 200M water resistant classic rugged quartz watch with a black resin strap, countdown timer, split time stopwatch, and perpetual calendar.

name: Levi's Men's 511 Slim Fit Jeans
description: A modern slim with room to move. These 511 Slim Fit Jeans are classic since day one, cut close but not too close for all-day comfort.

name: Nike Club Fleece Hoodie
description: A classic pullover hoodie crafted from soft, brushed fleece for warm comfort. Features adjustable drawcord hood and standard athletic kangaroo pocket.

name: Adidas Essentials Regular Fit Tee
description: Simple, clean style meets supreme athletic comfort. Features the iconic Adidas linear logo across the chest, crafted from sustainable soft cotton single jersey.

name: Zara Floral Print Summer Dress
description: Lightweight flowing dress featuring a flattering V-neck, short sleeves with elastic trim, front button fastening, and a vibrant all-over floral print.

name: H&M Ribbed Knit Cable Sweater
description: Soft knit cable sweater featuring a ribbed crew neck, dropped shoulders, long sleeves, and ribbed trim at the cuffs and hem for cozy winter wear.

name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 40
description: A springy ride for every run, the Peg's familiar, just-for-you feel returns to help you accomplish your goals. Breathable mesh upper with springy Zoom Air.

name: Adidas Stan Smith Classic Sneakers
description: Originally created for tennis star Stan Smith, these clean leather shoes have been style icons since the 1970s. Premium full-grain leather construction.

name: Clarks Luxury Leather Oxford Shoes
description: Crafted from hand-burnished premium leather, these classic oxfords feature a clean silhouette, leather lining, and padded footbeds for elegant formal wear.

name: Timberland Suede Penny Loafers
description: Premium suede penny loafers with a traditional slot strap detail. Slip-on design features anti-fatigue removable footbeds for all-day cushioning.

name: Ray-Ban Polarized Aviator Sunglasses
description: The classic Aviator shape with gold frames and crystal green polarized lenses. Originally designed for US aviators, providing superior UV protection.

name: Dyson V15 Detect Cordless Vacuum
description: Dyson's most powerful, intelligent cordless vacuum with laser illumination. Engineered for deep cleaning of carpets, wood floors, and pet hair.

name: Starbucks Dark Roast Coffee Beans
description: Starbucks French Roast Dark Roast Whole Bean Coffee delivers a smoky and singular coffee flavor. Made with 100% Arabica coffee beans.

name: Lego Star Wars Millennium Falcon
description: Build and display the ultimate Star Wars collector model Millennium Falcon. Features intricate hull details, cockpit, radar dish, and minifigures.

name: Ergonomic Mesh Office Chair
description: High-back mesh office desk chair featuring adjustable lumbar support, 3D armrests, dynamic recline lock, and breathable nylon mesh backrest.
